- Finished: City interface version navigation & provenance trails workflow (markdown + image schematic); overall city UI source/provenance overlays are complete for basic workflow.
- Next (open from last session): Gather feedback on new schematic and overall version/provenance design; extend overlays and workflows by review and edge/audit cases.

## Choose single highest-value increment
Review and expansion are bottlenecked on feedback and integration, but the actionable increment is:
**"Extend overlays and version/provenance review tools for deep audit and accessibility, e.g. auditing who changed what, when, and surfacing change impact."**

### Next step: 
- Draft a **city interface overlay and workflow spec for deep/explicit audit mode** (city-interface-audit-mode-workflow-v1.md), integrating:
    - How a user/auditor would select a zone, record, or team to see a timeline of versions/provenance, filter by agent/human, and mark nodes as audited/flagged.
    - Accessibility: ensuring these tools are reachable in minimal/mobile context.
    - Schematic—set data and UI pathways for how an audit or flag propagates.

I will write this spec as a markdown file, referencing integration points with the already shipped overlays.
